errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states that the chart illustrates changes in the number of issued construction permits for new buildings, categorized by administrative, other, and residential buildings, based on NSI data. The machine-generated description omits mentioning the data source (НСИ).
The reference description mentions that the Y-axis has no markings (labels or tick intervals), which is omitted in the machine-generated description.
The machine-generated description states that the gray line (Жилищни) reaches 5980 in 2019, but the figure shows the value as 5860 for 2019. The correct value for 5980 is in 2018.

The machine-generated description states that the orange line (Други) reaches 4685 in 2021, but the figure shows the value as 4631 for 2021. The value 4685 is shown in 2022 for the gray line (Жилищни).
The reference description mentions that the orange line (Други) reaches its highest value in 2017 (5460), which is not explicitly highlighted as a key point in the machine-generated description.
The reference description notes that the gray line (Жилищни) surpasses the 5000 threshold in 2017 (5562), which is not mentioned in the machine-generated description.

The reference description highlights the sharp increase in the gray line (Жилищни) between 2020 and 2021 (from 5860 to 7047), which is not explicitly described as a 'sharp increase' in the machine-generated description.
